mapper.sql: id, message_type, business_id, exchange, routing_key, queue_name, payload, status, retry_count, error_msg, create_time, update_time
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO message_records (message_type, business_id, exchange, routing_key, queue_name, payload, status, retry_count, error_msg, create_time) VALUES (#{messageType}, #{businessId}, #{exchange}, #{routingKey}, #{queueName}, #{payload}, #{status}, #{retryCount}, #{errorMsg}, NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT FROM message_records WHERE business_id = #{businessId} AND message_type = #{messageType} LIMIT 1
SELECT FROM message_records WHERE status = 0 ORDER BY create_time ASC LIMIT #{limit}
